description:
**Requisition ID:** 73946

**About Whirlpool India**

Whirlpool of India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram, is a leading home appliances company dedicated to enhancing life at home and inspiring generations through its trusted brands. The company operates three state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Faridabad, Pune & Puducherry, each reflecting Whirlpool’s commitment to providing best-in-class consumer solutions. Further driving innovation, the company has a Technology & Engineering Center, where India's world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation. In the 2024-25 fiscal year, Whirlpool of India reported approximately INR 8110 Cr in annual revenue and employed 2193 people. More information is available at www.india.whirlpool.in

**The team you will be a part of:**
-----------------------------------

The Product Design team designs, validates and brings new products to market; designs, tests and integrates components to produce final designs; and evaluates the design's overall effectiveness, cost, reliability and safety. Collaborates with internal partners to optimize designs for manufacturability. Uses CAD/CAE systems to model new designs and produce detailed engineering drawings.

**This role in summary:**
-------------------------

Currently, we are seeking a passionate and creative candidate for an UX Design opening to join our Design Team at Whirlpool of India Ltd-Gurugram.

At Whirlpool of India Ltd, people are the heart of our mission – our valued customers and dedicated employees. Our User Experience team seeks to understand the changing needs of
  
our users and to combine that knowledge with the latest in technology. You will be an integral part of the team, designing experiences that make people’s homes more convenient and joyful,
  
and in doing so, improving the lives of millions of people.

In this role you will be able to Research, Design and innovate in the areas of Digital and Physical User experience, Work on behavior specification of products, benchmarking in Appliance Industry and other parallel industries, home immersions to useful insights and come up with harmonious and holistic solutions.

If you’re passionate about developing experiences like this and tick most of the boxes for this role, we would be delighted to hear from you.

A comprehensive portfolio demonstrating direct, individual contributions to both physical and digital design execution is required for consideration. Proven experience designing HMI/
  
physical-digital products / appliances, grounded in Human centred ways of designing HMI, Usability research, Market trend and Benchmarking studies.

**Your responsibilities will include:**
---------------------------------------

* **Field Research & Generative Research :** Conduct deep qualitative user research , ethnography and home immersions to capture authentic consumer behaviors and pain points. Translate raw research data into core insights that feed directly into Design Team
* **UX Strategy (Physical-Digital ):** Design seamless end-to-end user experiences that merge physical HMI (dials, tactile buttons, touch screens, LED indicators) with digital ecosystems (mobile applications, IoT controls and smart home systems).
* **Evaluative Research / Usability Research & Validation:** Design, plan, and conduct qualitative and quantitative usability studies for planned projects in execution, context of use testing, and ergonomic assessments to iteratively validate physical and digital design concepts with real users.
* **Interaction Documentation & Team Collaboration:** Document precise interaction behaviors and logic flows for the software development team. Drive continuous refinement of the user experience through heavy cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Hardware, Mechanical Engineering, and other key stakeholders.
* **Market & Trend Benchmarking**: Perform constant local (India) & global market research, India White goods space and parallel Industry competitive audits, IoT trend analysis to uncover unmet customer demands and inform the product experience roadmap for planning cycles
* **Perceived Quality & Execution Excellence:** Benchmark and evaluate perceived quality to ensure top-tier standards in overall product , physical control feel, surface finish, UI responsiveness, visual elegance and overall product elegance.
* **Human Factors & Ergonomics:** Apply core principles of physical ergonomics and cognitive workload to optimize control panel layouts, display visibility, reachability, and overall product interaction across diverse user demographics.
* **Foster the future:** Actively seek and share design and digital inspiration. Be on top of understanding new innovations and to keep a check on the market trends. Cross Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Industrial Designers, Software/Firmware Engineers, Product Managers and external Design Agencies from concept through to launch.

You will be a key member of the UX team that’s responsible for driving Digital and Physical experience strategy by collaborating effectively with the Engineering and Marketing teams to align on experience/product roadmaps Championing the UX processes and projects, ensuring that each project consistently expresses the intended brand personality and delivering an intuitive and delightful experience.

**Minimum requirements:**
-------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master’s in Industrial Design, Interaction Design, Service Design, Visual Design, HCI or related human center degree
* **Experience:** 2-5 years of experience planning, conducting, and communicating the findings from user research for products and services
* Strong Design / User Research / User Insight / Visual design skills required, including the use of a diverse set of tools, e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Generative AI tools, and the ability to adapt to new and evolving software based on existing design methodology, principles and practices
* Experience planning and conducting Research (quantitative /qualitative/ usability user research) at all stages of product development
* Ability to direct clear and creative artifacts (e.g., task flows, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to guide consistency across teams)
* Seasoned design expertise with deep insight into the newest methods, trends, and design operations
* Ability to frame key questions, create research plans to address those, conduct research, and synthesize the findings into meaningful, actionable insights
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate and optimize design based on the value to the user and the business
* Strong communication skills with the ability to align the organization on complex product decisions while advocating the voice of the customer
* Ability to effectively document, present and gather feedback from peers, stakeholders and others in order to inform and align
* Ability to scope product and service projects strategically and effectively with a deep understanding of product development processes
* Passion to challenge the status quo find new solutions and drive out-of-the-box ideas – loves and embraces change
* Visible passion for the subject area, participation in domain activities and groups
* Experimental mindset to drive innovation

**Preferred skills and experiences:**
-------------------------------------

* Developing design systems for apps or embedded UIs for each brand to guarantee a consistent application and following the Product Organisation process, working closely with process partners
* You will work in tandem with the Industrial Designers to enable an efficient iterative design process that constantly strives to leading product portfolio the industry
* Leading with rapid prototyping, ranging from quick paper mockups to interactive prototypes developed in conjunction with engineering teams – targeting the right fidelity at the right time
* Aligning key leaders and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure meeting the brand goals and to align with them on the design direction
* Understanding business goals, making them meaningful and actionable for the team.

**What we offer:**
------------------

Whirlpool has big plans for the future, just like you. We understand that it takes preparation and hard work to get there. So, we offer great teams and tools to build your capability. In our
  
performance-based setting, you can take your career in exciting new directions - and as far as you want to go.
